answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the meadow is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest sable a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Scaling the ripple therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal td6to.
